acceptance_criteria_evidence.evidence: Interrupt state is persisted durably and reloaded across process instances retaining version, role, summary, and payload.
Strict role hierarchy check (STUDENT < STAFF < ADMIN) and expected_state_version match enforce advance permissions.
Atomic resolve_and_execute prevents duplicate or replay review decisions from executing actions repeatedly.
Execution is deterministic under fakes, restricted within write_scope, and emits no credentials or leaks.
